page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance deployed on x86_64 architecture utilizing the KVM hypervisor. Hardware infrastructure includes 80 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a 3.1 GHz clock speed. System memory is provisioned at 768.0 GB, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio of 9.6 GB per core. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 25 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Ephemeral local storage is not included on this instance type, making persistent block storage integration necessary.

The instance structure delivers high memory density relative to core count, tailored for memory-bound computational requirements. The absence of local disk drives requires reliance on attached network storage for disk operations, shifting disk performance characteristics onto the storage network. Qualitatively, the hardware density per vCPU provides efficient scale for memory-intensive workloads, including in-memory database management systems, enterprise caching architectures, real-time analytics platforms, and enterprise application software.
